pipeline.title: BioNTech pays $205M for FDA voucher to speed up ‘late-stage oncology pipeline’
pipeline.summary: BioNTech has agreed to pay $205 million to purchase an FDA priority review voucher to support a future filing of a drug in its “late-stage oncology pipeline.” Fierce breaks down which candidate is most likely to claim the regulatory accelerator.

pipeline.title: Amgen builds Sjögren’s case with detailed phase 3 data ahead of Novartis showdown
pipeline.summary: Amgen has shared more data from a phase 3 Sjögren’s disease trial that dazzled analysts, digging into the details that could shape its showdown with Novartis.

pipeline.title: Abbott nabs FDA approval, CE Mark for implantable cardioverter-defibrillator lead
pipeline.summary: Abbott has received both FDA and CE Mark approval for its UltiSynq defibrillation lead tech, which is designed to deliver both conduction system pacing and defibrillation therapy.

pipeline.title: Merck KGaA lands FDA nod in rare tumor disorder, portending Ono, Daiichi showdown
pipeline.summary: The FDA’s decision was based on Merck’s phase 3 Maneuver trial and follows similar approvals by other global regulators, including in China, Canada and Switzerland.

pipeline.title: Beam’s sickle cell therapy results tee up potential Casgevy, Lyfgenia showdown
pipeline.summary: Gearing up for a potential FDA filing by the end of the year, Beam Therapeutics revealed results from a phase 1/2 study of its base-edited cell therapy risto-cel, showing the potential sickle cell treatment reduced the most painful complications of the blood disease for a full ye

pipeline.title: ImmunityBio juggles phase 3 win and 20% stock crash en route to Anktiva front-line expansion
pipeline.summary: ImmunityBio's Anktiva secured a pivotal phase 3 win in front-line non-muscle invasive bladder cancer, but lack of detailed data and disappointing third-quarter financials sent the biotech's stock tumbling by 20%.

pipeline.title: PepGen’s stock doubles as midphase muscle dystrophy data wow analysts
pipeline.summary: PepGen’s phase 2 myotonic dystrophy type 1 data have met analysts’ best-case scenario, causing the biotech’s share price to more than double.

pipeline.title: J&J readies Caplyta for FDA label expansion after 2nd phase 3 win in bipolar mania
pipeline.summary: J&J is gearing up to expand the commercial reach of Caplyta after scoring a second phase 3 victory in bipolar mania.

pipeline.title: Mirum scores again in hepatitis D phase 3, setting the stage for brelovitug’s FDA run
pipeline.summary: Mirum Pharmaceuticals has kept its clinical winning streak alive in hepatitis D, meeting the primary endpoint in another late-stage trial of its antiviral monoclonal antibody brelovitug.

pipeline.title: Novocure denied FDA approval for Optune Mya cancer device after efficacy concerns
pipeline.summary: Novocure has been hit with a relatively rare “not approvable” letter from the FDA for its tumor-treating electric fields device.

pipeline.title: Merck’s MASH hopeful efinopegdutide wins in mid-stage study
pipeline.summary: Merck & Co. revealed results from a mid-stage clinical trial showing its GLP-1 and glucagon receptor co-agonist efinopegdutide resolved cases of MASH compared with placebo without worsening liver fibrosis.

pipeline.title: Veradermics wraps phase 3 program in men with 'better-than-expected' hair growth at 1 year
pipeline.summary: In a new readout of 12-month data, Veradermics' oral minoxidil delivered the best hair growth data of its phase 3 program so far alongside solid one-year safety data.

pipeline.title: J&J’s Icotyde pill drives biologic-like efficacy in psoriatic arthritis despite high-dose miss
pipeline.summary: Icotyde's strong phase 3 data in biologic-naïve patients with psoriatic arthritis were stained by one disappointment as a high dose missed statistical significance on the primary endpoint.

pipeline.title: Zura scraps hidradenitis suppurativa program after phase 2 miss, sinking stock
pipeline.summary: Zura Bio’s tibulizumab has flunked a phase 2 hidradenitis suppurativa trial, prompting the biotech to end development in the indication while continuing studies in other settings.

pipeline.title: J&J-backed Delix drums up $100M series C for non-hallucinatory psychedelic for depression
pipeline.summary: Delix Therapeutics has raised $100 million in a series C round backed by the likes of Johnson & Johnson to advance a phase 2-ready non-hallucinatory psychedelic therapy for depression.

pipeline.title: Lilly looks to gird Foundayo label after late-stage win in sleep apnea
pipeline.summary: Lilly's oral GLP-1 Foundayo significantly reduced sleep apnea severity in a phase 3 study presented at the AHA Scientific Sessions on Monday. Now, the pharma is approaching the FDA in hopes of a label expansion.

pipeline.title: Recent Lisata prize Marea touts ‘exciting’ lipid disorder phase 2 win, mulls obesity potential
pipeline.summary: Fresh from a merger with oncology drugmaker Lisata Therapeutics, cardiometabolic biotech Marea Therapeutics has revealed results from the first part of a phase 2b study showing its drug candidate MAR001 significantly reduced levels of fat in the blood of patients with hypertrigly

pipeline.title: AHA: Boehringer aims for 2027 survodutide submission after obesity drug passes cardio test
pipeline.summary: Boehringer Ingelheim is gearing up to take survodutide to regulators next year after the obesity drug proved its cardiovascular credentials in its latest phase 3 study.

pipeline.title: Drug price hikes in Germany could push US costs higher, study says
pipeline.summary: The report comes amid escalating tensions between the U.S. and Germany over drug prices, with several large pharmaceutical companies responding by scaling back investments in the country.

pipeline.title: Legend Biotech shares fall 16% after first earnings report under new CEO
pipeline.summary: Legend Biotech’s shares tumbled 16% Tuesday following the CAR-T company’s third-quarter earnings report, marking a rocky debut for newly installed CEO Ingrid Zhang.

pipeline.title: Valo and Montai become one as the Flagship AI-based biotechs tie the knot
pipeline.summary: Two Flagship Pioneering-founded AI drug discovery and development biotechs, Valo Health and Montai Therapeutics, will join forces in a merger that aims to advance Montai’s early-stage and preclinical pipeline as well as continue a series of big-name partnerships already in tow.

pipeline.title: AstraZeneca buys vaccine startup; FDA issues GLP-1 safety warning
pipeline.summary: The deal gives AstraZeneca a simpler way to make conjugate vaccines. Elsewhere, a psychedelic depression drug was submitted to the FDA and an autoimmune disease-focused biotech’s shares collapsed.

pipeline.title: Aurobindo unit Eugia recalls antibiotic lot, citing glass particle concerns
pipeline.summary: Eugia, a unit of Aurobindo, issued a voluntary recall for one lot of the antibiotic vancomycin hydrochloride for injection, citing the possible presence of glass particles in the vials.

pipeline.title: Capricor, NextCure shed light on recent layoffs as they gear up for approval decision, merger
pipeline.summary: Capricor and NextCure have shed light on recent rounds of layoffs, as the biotechs brace for a hoped-for drug approval and merger, respectively.

pipeline.title: Lilly’s Foundayo marketing push keeps pace with another celeb partner in comedian Leanne Morgan
pipeline.summary: The new celebrity partnership is the second for Lilly's oral GLP-1 Foundayo following its recent partnership with lifestyle guru Martha Stewart.

pipeline.title: PepGen soars on promising early data for muscular dystrophy drug
pipeline.summary: While from a small study, the findings suggest PepGen’s therapy compares favorably to other RNA-based medicines in testing at Novartis and Dyne Therapeutics.

pipeline.title: Oura to acquire AI virtual primary care partner Counsel Health for $625M
pipeline.summary: The companies have worked together since June, and more recently had shared plans to partner on CMS' 10-year ACCESS Model.

pipeline.title: Beam’s base editing therapy for sickle cell hits goal in pivotal trial
pipeline.summary: The result represents a scientific milestone and positions Beam to submit a first-of-its-kind FDA application as soon as the end of the year.

pipeline.title: Summit sheds commercial leaders ahead of ivonescimab's FDA decision
pipeline.summary: Summit Therapeutics is gearing up for ivonescimab’s high-stakes FDA decision without its chief commercial officer following a quiet shake-up of its launch division.

pipeline.title: AstraZeneca buys partner Omniose for bacterial vaccine technology
pipeline.summary: AstraZeneca has acquired vaccine bioconjugation specialist Omniose, securing technology and expertise that could boost its efforts to protect people from bacterial threats.

pipeline.title: FDA orders new eye risk be listed on a dozen GLP-1s, including Novo's Ozempic, Lilly's Zepbound
pipeline.summary: After an internal investigation, the FDA is calling for 12 GLP-1s to add a new and rare eye risk to the "warnings and precautions" section of their labels.

pipeline.title: After court win, WuXi AppTec scores removal from US list of Chinese military companies
pipeline.summary: Following a back-and-forth with the Pentagon this year, contracting juggernaut WuXi AppTec appears to have largely evaded its designation by the U.S. as a company with ties to the Chinese military.

pipeline.title: Phillips Medisize strikes deal to expand UK inhalation production
pipeline.summary: Phillips Medisize, a Molex subsidiary CDMO that focuses on inhalation products and other medical and diagnostic products, is growing its manufacturing footprint in the U.K.

pipeline.title: AbCellera becomes latest biotech to abandon dream of developing OX40 drug
pipeline.summary: AbCellera has become the latest drug developer to abandon its attempts to crack the OX40 code.

pipeline.title: AchieveRx stubs out old identity ahead of smoking cessation launch
pipeline.summary: Achieve Life Sciences has rebranded to align its name and stock ticker with its focus on helping people quit smoking and vaping.

pipeline.title: UCB continues reign as largest drug ad spender as Bimzelx once again tops the ranks
pipeline.summary: UCB’s immunology drug Bimzelx has topped the pharma drug ad spending charts for the third month in a row.

pipeline.title: Coherus shrinks headcount 30% to narrow focus of cancer combo
pipeline.summary: Coherus Oncology is once again laying off 30% of its workforce as the biopharma narrows the focus of its CCR8-targeting antibody on esophageal cancer.

pipeline.title: Deerfield Management Partners with Amazon’s AWS for AI drive in life sciences
pipeline.summary: Deerfield Management announced a collaboration with Amazon Web Services (AWS) aiming to accelerate the development and scaling of AI-native healthcare and life sciences companies in its portfolio.

pipeline.title: London biotech Oyster harvests $60M for tau-targeting brain drugs
pipeline.summary: Oyster says a tweak it's made to traditional protein degrading technology can help break down tau, which has long been a focus of Alzheimer’s drug research.

pipeline.title: BIO unveils plan for US to remain biotech’s ‘global leader’
pipeline.summary: A seven-part proposal from the prominent lobbyist lays out a series of initiatives to accelerate drug development in the U.S. and counter China’s fast rise.

pipeline.title: Insulet, Marvel Comics smash diabetes stigma with new Omnipod-powered superhero
pipeline.summary: Insulet's newest Marvel Comics collab looks to empower people with diabetes by representing the community through a new diabetes superhero, Gluconaut in "Gluconaut: Strength of Stars."

pipeline.title: Bayer wins FDA nod for a new kind of blood thinner
pipeline.summary: Sunharbo’s U.S. approval is the first for a “Factor XIa” inhibitor, an anticipated class of medicines seen as a possible step forward in stroke prevention.

pipeline.title: Vertex lays off 78 Crinetics staffers amid $10B integration
pipeline.summary: Vertex has decided to lay off 78 employees at Crinetics Pharmaceuticals following its $10 billion acquisition of the endocrine disease drug developer.

pipeline.title: Vir hepatitis D drug succeeds in first pivotal study
pipeline.summary: A program that’s survived Vir’s pivot away from infectious disease research hit all of its study objectives and appeared more potent than a rival drug also in late-stage development.

pipeline.title: Argenx to buy peptide platform in potentially billion-dollar deal
pipeline.summary: For $550 million up front, Argenx will take control of Unnatural Products’ “macrocyclic peptide” technology and direct it to develop oral, durable medicines for serious immune-mediated diseases.

pipeline.title: FDA opens safety probe into Novartis’ Zolgensma over potential tumor risks
pipeline.summary: In its Nov. 6 communique about its Zolgensma safety probe, the FDA also flagged two recent reports of other gene therapy candidates where AAV vector integration drove tumor formation.

pipeline.title: Ramaswamy’s biotech baggage haunted his political run
pipeline.summary: A pivotal Alzheimer’s trial tied to Vivek Ramaswamy’s political rise is a tale of failed endpoints.

pipeline.title: Spruce spins out preclinical endocrinology program into newly formed Adrenyx
pipeline.summary: Spruce Biosciences is spinning out a preclinical endocrinology program into a newly formed subsidiary called Adrenyx Biosciences, supported with up to $50 million from an unnamed investor.

pipeline.title: Moderna moves UK commercial digs to heart of London's 'knowledge quarter'
pipeline.summary: Sticking by the strong relationship it’s fostered with the U.K., mRNA specialist Moderna is relocating its home base in the country.

pipeline.title: Could we see 10 Chinese Big Pharmas within a decade? Some CEOs think so
pipeline.summary: For executives at many of the Chinese drug developers who spoke to Fierce, the real prize is a seat at the Big Pharma table. In recent years, this objective has moved from a vague aspiration to a concrete goal.

pipeline.title: ‘Flying blind’: Why experts fear Treasury’s China biotech investment crackdown will backfire
pipeline.summary: The U.S. Treasury's COINS Act proposal aims to shield U.S. biotech from Chinese competition, but insiders warn it will backfire. As lawyers scramble to decipher an ambiguous ban on cross-border "joint ventures," they flag that Washington's national security priorities have expand

pipeline.title: ‘Cancer hasn't seen this molecule before’: Onchilles’ injection shows potential for solid tumors
pipeline.summary: The San Diego-based biotech has shown that when its vaccine-like therapeutic, N17350, is injected directly into the tumor, the candidate is even able to clear cancer lesions that are distant from the injected tumor.

pipeline.title: Agentic AI Is Rewriting The Pharma Marketing Playbook
pipeline.summary: AI is transforming how the pharma industry approaches drug development.

pipeline.title: Bayer brings factor XIa to US stroke prevention with FDA nod for 1st-in-class asundexian
pipeline.summary: Shortly after locking down a world-first approval in China, Bayer is bringing its groundbreaking stroke prevention drug stateside, with an FDA green light that honors the German drugmaker’s cardiovascular heritage and signals the sort of first-in-class opportunities it’s increasi

pipeline.title: Asking More of Science: How Daiichi Sankyo Is Challenging Assumptions About the Future of Cancer Care
pipeline.summary: See how Daiichi Sankyo is asking more of science to bring the next wave of innovation to patients.

pipeline.title: Fierce Biotech Layoff Tracker 2026: Vertex trims 78 employees; Coherus lays off 30% of workforce
pipeline.summary: As always, if you know of layoffs occurring at a biotech, please reach out to the Fierce Biotech editorial team.

pipeline.title: Fierce Biotech Fundraising Tracker '26: VectorY wins $83.5M; Oyster cracks $60M series A
pipeline.summary: The Fierce Biotech Fundraising Tracker records venture capital rounds of $50 million or more secured by biotechs.
